verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference API, and such APIs can plausibly accept remote MCP servers as tools, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions MCP server connections. Generic tool-call support and OpenAI Responses API compatibility are developer building blocks rather than an MCP-client capability. Connecting Claude Code or Codex makes Munito the model backend for those clients, which is the reverse of this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
